```{r helpers}
# ---- Formatting ------------------------------------------------------
fmt <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
pfmt <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", fmt(p, 3))           # for tables
pv   <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste("=", fmt(p, 3)))  # for prose: "p `r pv(x)`"
stars <- function(p) as.character(symnum(p, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE,
  cutpoints = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 1), symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "")))

tbl <- function(x, caption, digits = 3, ...) {
  x <- mutate(x, across(where(is.numeric) & matches("p-value| p$"), pfmt))
  kbl(x, booktabs = TRUE, digits = digits, caption = caption, linesep = "", ...) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 9)
}

# Display labels for regressors
labels <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
  SP500   = "S&P 500 return",       USD     = "USD index return",
  VIX     = "VIX (monthly avg.)",   dVIX    = "Change in VIX",
  Gold    = "Gold return",          d10Y    = "Change in US 10Y yield",
  PH_CPI  = "PH CPI inflation (YoY)", USDPHP = "USD/PHP change",
  PH_Mfg  = "PH manufacturing growth (YoY)",
  D_Mar20 = "Dummy: March 2020",    D_May20 = "Dummy: May 2020")
lab <- function(x) unname(coalesce(labels[x], x))

# ---- Inference -------------------------------------------------------
# Newey-West HAC covariance; lag 3 ~ T^(1/4) for T = 96 monthly observations
nw <- function(m) NeweyWest(m, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE)

coef_tab <- function(m, V = vcov(m)) {
  ct <- coeftest(m, vcov. = V)
  ci <- coefci(m, vcov. = V)
  tibble(Term = lab(rownames(ct)), Estimate = ct[, 1], `Std. Error` = ct[, 2],
         `t value` = ct[, 3], `p-value` = ct[, 4],
         `95% CI low` = ci[, 1], `95% CI high` = ci[, 2])
}

# Side-by-side "estimate*** (SE)" columns; `cts` is a named list of coeftest results
side_by_side <- function(cts) {
  imap(cts, ~ tibble(term = rownames(.x),
                     !!.y := sprintf("%.3f%s (%.3f)", .x[, 1], stars(.x[, 4]), .x[, 2]))) %>%
    reduce(full_join, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, "")), term = lab(term)) %>%
    rename(Term = term)
}

# ---- Fit and diagnostics (one row per model) ---------------------------
fit_tab <- function(models) imap_dfr(models, function(m, nm) {
  s <- summary(m)
  tibble(Model = nm, N = nobs(m), k = length(coef(m)) - 1,
         `R2` = s$r.squared, `Adj. R2` = s$adj.r.squared, `Resid. SE` = s$sigma,
         `F` = s$fstatistic[[1]],
         `F p-value` = pf(s$fstatistic[[1]], s$fstatistic[[2]], s$fstatistic[[3]], lower.tail = FALSE),
         AIC = AIC(m), BIC = BIC(m))
})

diag_tab <- function(models) imap_dfr(models, function(m, nm) tibble(
  Model                 = nm,
  `Max VIF`             = max(vif(m)),
  `Breusch-Pagan p`     = bptest(m)$p.value,
  `White p`             = bptest(m, ~ fitted(m) + I(fitted(m)^2))$p.value,
  `Durbin-Watson`       = unname(dwtest(m)$statistic),
  `Breusch-Godfrey(12) p` = bgtest(m, order = 12)$p.value,
  `Jarque-Bera p`       = jarque.bera.test(residuals(m))$p.value,
  `RESET p`             = resettest(m, power = 2:3)$p.value))
```

```{r data-collection}
# Raw monthly levels are downloaded once and cached in data/raw_monthly.csv.
# Delete that file to re-download everything from the original sources.
raw_file   <- "data/raw_monthly.csv"
case_start <- as.Date("2018-01-01")
case_end   <- as.Date("2025-12-31")
fetch_from <- as.Date("2016-01-01")  # extra history for returns and YoY rates

# Collapse a daily xts series to one value per month
to_monthly <- function(x, f = last) {
  m <- apply.monthly(na.omit(x[, 1]), f)
  tibble(Date = floor_date(index(m), "month"), value = as.numeric(m))
}
fred  <- function(id, f = last)
  to_monthly(getSymbols(id, src = "FRED", from = fetch_from, auto.assign = FALSE), f)
yahoo <- function(id)
  to_monthly(Cl(getSymbols(id, src = "yahoo", from = fetch_from,
                           to = case_end + 1, auto.assign = FALSE)))

# PSA OpenSTAT (PXWeb) query -> tibble(Date, value), one row per month
psa <- function(table, query, period_var) {
  url  <- paste0("https://openstat.psa.gov.ph/PXWeb/api/v1/en/DB/", table)
  json <- function(res) fromJSON(sub("^﻿", "", httr::content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")))
  meta <- json(httr::GET(url))$variables
  body <- toJSON(list(query = query, response = list(format = "json")), auto_unbox = TRUE)
  dat  <- json(httr::POST(url, body = body, httr::content_type_json()))$data
  lab  <- function(code, i) with(meta[meta$code == code, ], valueTexts[[1]][match(i, values[[1]])])
  keys <- do.call(rbind, dat$key)
  tibble(year  = lab("Year", keys[, ncol(keys) - 1]),
         month = lab(period_var, keys[, ncol(keys)]),
         value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(dat$values)))) %>%
    filter(month %in% c(month.abb, month.name)) %>%
    transmute(Date = as.Date(paste(year, substr(month, 1, 3), 1), "%Y %b %d"), value)
}
pick <- function(code, values) list(code = code, selection = list(filter = "item", values = I(values)))

if (!file.exists(raw_file)) {
  # Headline CPI (2018=100), Philippines, all items: backcast 2016-17 + 2018 onwards
  cpi_q  <- list(pick("Geolocation", "0"), pick("Commodity Description", "0"))
  ph_cpi <- bind_rows(
    psa("2M/PI/CPI/2018NEW/0012M4ACP28.px", cpi_q, "Period"),
    psa("2M/PI/CPI/2018NEW/0012M4ACP22.px", cpi_q, "Period"))
  # MISSI Volume of Production Index, total manufacturing (2018=100)
  ph_mfg <- bind_rows(
    psa("2G/MNFG/MISSI/BAC/0012G4CMPO1.px",
        list(pick("PSIC/Industry", "0"), pick("Item", "0")), "Month"),
    psa("2G/MNFG/MISSI/2018/0032G4CMPO2.px",
        list(pick("Industry Group/Division", "0"), pick("Item", "0")), "Month"))

  raw <- list(
    WTI          = fred("DCOILWTICO"),
    SP500        = fred("SP500"),
    USD_Index    = fred("DTWEXBGS"),
    VIX          = fred("VIXCLS", mean),
    Gold         = yahoo("GC=F"),
    US_10Y_Yield = fred("DGS10"),
    PH_CPI_Index = ph_cpi,
    USD_PHP      = yahoo("PHP=X"),
    PH_VoPI      = ph_mfg
  ) %>%
    imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := value)) %>%
    reduce(full_join, by = "Date") %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    filter(Date >= fetch_from, Date <= case_end)
  write_csv(raw, raw_file)
}
raw <- read_csv(raw_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
```
